children: Embassy Developments share price will remain in focus on September 22 after company signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) for the sale of an entire residential tower at its ultra-luxury Embassy Terazza project in Juhu to Dinesh Thakkar, Founder, Chairman and Managing Director of Angel One.
The transaction involves a G+7-storey tower with a RERA carpet area of 63,000 sq ft and is valued at approximately ₹711 crore.
Embassy Terazza is spread across more than 2 acres, with an estimated gross development value (GDV) of over ₹3,000 crore.
Catch all the market action on our live blog
On September 19, the company’s board approved raising up to ₹160 crore through the issuance of up to 16,000 non-convertible debentures (NCDs) of ₹1 lakh each on a private placement basis.
In the quarter ended June 2026, the realty firm had posted a consolidated net loss of Rs 234.40 crore against net loss of Rs 165.64 crore in the year-ago period.
For the June quarter, the company reported a 338 percent year-on-year jump in pre-sales to Rs 868 crore, while collections rose 54 percent to Rs 496 crore.
The company has a presence in Bengaluru, Mumbai Metropolitan Region (MMR), Delhi-NCR, Chennai, and Indore.

title: Embassy Developments shares in focus on signing ₹711cr deal for residential tower at Juhu
